name: p01_pillow
prompt: First-person POV cinematic 16:9 film still, lying on your side in bed at 1 a.m.: your own hand in a charcoal hoodie sleeve holds a smartphone close, its cool blue light spilling on a rumpled white duvet; beyond it a tall window streams with rain, orange city lights blurred. No face visible. 35mm, shallow depth of field, film grain, teal and amber grade.

name: p02_sitting
prompt: First-person POV cinematic 16:9 film still at night: sitting up in bed, knees raised under a white duvet, both hands in charcoal hoodie sleeves holding a smartphone showing a cream-colored book page; dark bedroom, rain on the window behind, cool phone light on the hands. No face. 35mm, film grain.

name: p03_sneakers_step
prompt: First-person POV cinematic 16:9 night shot looking straight down at your own feet: spotless white sneakers and dark jeans stepping out over a doorstep onto wet, rain-glossed city pavement, streetlight reflections, raindrops. 35mm, film grain.

name: p04_walk_flood
prompt: First-person POV cinematic 16:9 night shot walking along a stone river embankment in heavy rain, the edge of a dark hood at the top of the frame, a white earbud cable swinging at the edge; ahead the lower path is flooded with shallow rippling water reflecting sodium streetlights, the black river to the right, far embankment and trees beyond. 35mm, anamorphic, film grain.

name: p05_soaked
prompt: First-person POV cinematic 16:9 night shot looking straight down: your own white sneakers standing ankle-deep in dark rippling floodwater on stone paving, rain drops hitting the surface, hem of a dark wool coat and dark jeans at the top of frame, sodium streetlight reflections. 35mm, film grain.

name: p06_clock
prompt: First-person POV cinematic 16:9 night shot sitting up in bed: in the foreground your hand holds a smartphone with a charging cable plugged in, cream book page on screen; on the bedside table a small digital clock reads 00:01; rain on the dark window. No face. 35mm, film grain.

name: p07_sliver
prompt: First-person POV cinematic 16:9 night shot of a completely dark bedroom where the only light is a smartphone screen held vertically in two hands, a bright narrow vertical sliver of warm cream light in the blackness, rain faintly visible on a window. Minimal, graphic, 35mm, film grain.

name: w04d_eye_only
prompt: Cinematic 16:9 period film still, 1816, extreme close-up from inside a pitch-dark wooden hovel: a narrow vertical gap between two rough planks; through the gap, firelight catches a single large pale grey human eye pressed close to the wood. Only the eye and a sliver of weathered skin, no scars, no stitches, no face. Candle amber and black, film grain.
